stemMd:
The two proposals differ in cost, but ______ would require closing the hall for a month. The committee must therefore consider disruption regardless of which proposal it selects.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: Either refers to whichever of the two proposals is selected. The following sentence confirms that closure and disruption apply under both possible choices.

distractorRationale.a: This would mean no proposal requires closure, contradicting the stated disruption under either selection.
distractorRationale.d: This pronoun refers to people rather than proposals.
distractorRationale.b: Only two specified proposals are under discussion; another would introduce a different one.
